edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, so the untrusted caller directly determines the owner state.
Constructor writes the untrusted msg.sender into the owner state variable that gates privileged functions.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before promoting the caller to owner.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with the caller-controlled newOwner value.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) after the handover.
transferOwnership stores the parameter _newOwner into the newOwner state variable.
The _newOwner parameter flows into the newOwner assignment.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller input controls which balance is reduced.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
The 'to' parameter is the credited destination in transfer.
The tokens parameter is the debited/credited amount in transfer.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], keyed by the untrusted caller.
approve stores the approved amount in the allowed mapping.
The spender parameter becomes the allowance key in approve.
The tokens parameter becomes the allowance value in approve.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender when decrementing allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom mutates balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom decrements the allowed allowance mapping.
The from parameter selects the balance and allowance entries debited by transferFrom.
The to parameter is the credited destination in transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is the amount moved by transferFrom.
transferFrom calls safeSub twice to decrease balance and allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
The tokenOwner parameter selects the queried balance entry.
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
The tokenOwner parameter is the outer allowance key.
The spender parameter is the inner allowance key.
approveAndCall keys the allowance by msg.sender and forwards msg.sender to the callback.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens.
The spender parameter determines both the allowance key and the external call target.
The tokens parameter becomes the allowance and is passed to the callback.
The data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
approveAndCall invokes an attacker-controlled contract whose receiveApproval can re-enter the token with the already-written allowance.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on an arbitrary token contract before returning, enabling reentrant behaviour.
transferAnyERC20Token sends tokens to the owner variable and is restricted by onlyOwner.
The tokenAddress parameter is the target of the external ERC20 transfer call.
The tokens parameter is the amount forwarded to the external token contract.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] in its subtraction.
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction of balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply.
safeAdd executes the raw addition that the graph treats as a potential overflow site.
safeSub executes the raw subtraction that the graph treats as a potential underflow site.
safeMul executes the raw multiplication checked only by c / a == b.
safeDiv executes the raw division guarded only by require(b > 0).
Parameter a feeds the safeAdd addition.
Parameter b feeds the safeAdd addition.
Parameter a feeds the safeSub subtraction.
Parameter b feeds the safeSub subtraction.
Parameter a feeds the safeMul multiplication.
Parameter b feeds the safeMul multiplication.
Parameter a feeds the safeDiv division.
Parameter b feeds the safeDiv division.
Local c receives and returns the safeAdd result.
Local c receives and returns the safeSub result.
Local c receives and returns the safeMul result.
Local c receives and returns the safeDiv result.

msg.sender is forwarded as the 'from' argument into the receiveApproval callback.
